look_here_first: LOOK FIRST at a FULLY MATURE spikelet: C. odoratus is unusual because a corky, winged spikelet RACHILLA disarticulates into one-fruited segments (each includes a scale, rachilla internode and achene). Usually subcylindrical spikelets; brown head color is secondary, not diagnostic.

project_inclusion.range_basis: Texas native at state level by reviewed FNA/POWO sources. Three distinct project-zone native-county records not independently certified. FNA treats a broad C. odoratus concept which can include C. engelmannii; POWO currently accepts C. engelmannii separately.

morphology_keys.habit: Annual or short-lived perennial in muddy wetland margins, shores or disturbed moist places, with large spreading leaflike terminal bracts.
morphology_keys.inflorescence: Umbel-like branching rays with headlets and elongated narrow spikelets, often rust-colored but variable.
morphology_keys.spikelets: Cylindrical or subcylindrical maturity. Corky winged rachilla breaks at each scale into one-fruited segments; this is key.
morphology_keys.scales: Disarticulating rachilla internode bears its floral scale and achene, not merely scales falling individually.
morphology_keys.fruit: Single achene per reduced flower; achene may remain clasped by a corky winged one-fruited rachilla segment.

comparisons.key_distinctions: C. strigosus flattened spikelets, larger deciduous scales and cormlike culm base. The FNA broad C. odoratus includes C. engelmannii, but POWO recognizes C. engelmannii separately; voucher-level identity needs review rather than an automatic synonym mapping.
comparisons.cautions: Taxonomy CONCEPT WARNING: preserve accepted C. odoratus L. anchor only; do NOT automatically map C. engelmannii observations into C. odoratus, and do not assign another accepted species without full reviewed specimen. Maturity, anatomy and county nativity need independent verification.

diagnostic_image_needs: Corky winged mature rachilla broken into individual one-fruited segments with 1 mm scale
Same specimen scale plus achene/internode dissected macro
Flat C. strigosus side-by-side mature spikelet and basal corm
Separate voucher-grade C. engelmannii comparison under POWO taxonomy
